result.text: Containment: the token desk (token_revoke) revokes exactly one payment token - only the token linked to the disputed charge, after the cardholder approves that exact revocation. Escalation: the dispute desk (dispute_submit) files exactly one transaction dispute, only after the April 4 18:00 no-reversal deadline, a current live ledger check and a new transaction-specific approval. Revoking a token is not a refund or a completed dispute; neither action freezes the card, resets other tokens or changes any payment schedule.
